8.issue_summary: **Silent Background Transfer**: Policy violation. Data is sent without prior disclosure.
8.evidence: Email is taken from Firebase User.email, providerData, and the Google account (lib/data/auth_controller.dart lines 38-54 and 97-105) and written to Firestore users/{uid}.email by UserProfileSync.upsertCurrentUser (lib/data/user_profile_sync.dart lines 17-22). That write runs from DdayCloudSync.start (lib/data/dday_cloud_sync.dart line 50), which AuthController starts from authStateChanges and ensureAnonymous (lib/data/auth_controller.dart lines 149-152 and 181-186), and from silent Google restore via _restoreGoogleAccount calling _linkFirebase (lib/data/auth_controller.dart lines 292 and 407-412). The email is stored under the Firebase uid, so it is linked to the account. Firestore is first-party. legal_copy.dart lines 109 and 238 mention the email address, but legal_screen.dart does not gate this upload.
8.recommendation: Obtain affirmative in-app consent that states the email address is stored in Firebase before upsertCurrentUser or silent Google restore runs. Declare Email in the Play Data Safety form.

14.issue_summary: USE_EXACT_ALARM is not justified. The app is a quotation companion (package com.quotation.quotation, launcher MainActivity) whose only exact alarm posts a local daily encouragement notification, not an alarm clock, timer, or calendar.
14.evidence: AndroidManifest.xml lines 7-8 declare android.permission.SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM and android.permission.USE_EXACT_ALARM. The MAIN/LAUNCHER activity is .MainActivity (lines 17-33) with home-widget and dearly://invite filters; there is no alarm-clock, timer, or calendar intent handler. MorningFortuneAlarm.arm() (MorningFortuneAlarm.kt lines 92-96) calls AlarmManager.setExactAndAllowWhileIdle(RTC_WAKEUP) on API 23+ or AlarmManager.setExact otherwise, so MorningFortuneReceiver can post notification channel daily_encouragement (MorningFortuneAlarm.kt lines 122-133, description 'Fortune at 8:00 and one afternoon encouragement'). That is a local daily notification, not second-critical clock or calendar functionality; the app remains useful without it. DailyWordWidgetProvider.scheduleHourlyRefresh (DailyWordWidgetProvider.kt lines 430-440) already uses AlarmManager.setInexactRepeating for hourly widget refresh and does not need an exact alarm.
14.recommendation: Remove android.permission.USE_EXACT_ALARM. Deliver the morning encouragement with inexact AlarmManager scheduling or WorkManager, matching the hourly widget refresh. If exact delivery is still required, keep only the already-declared SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM permission, which the user can revoke, and stop relying on the auto-granted USE_EXACT_ALARM permission.

15.issue_summary: Settings exposes a Google sign-in flow backed by Firebase Auth, so Play Console needs reviewer credentials and a public account-deletion URL.
15.evidence: settings_screen.dart lines 37-39 and 158-164 show an Account section Login button that calls authController.signIn(). auth_controller.dart lines 203-223 launch GoogleSignIn (scopes email and profile, serverClientId from GoogleAuthConfig). Lines 258-292 exchange the Google id token for a Firebase credential via linkWithCredential or signInWithCredential and then call UserProfileSync.upsertCurrentUser(). google_auth_config.dart lines 9-14 define the Google OAuth server client ID. initialize() also creates a Firebase session with signInAnonymously (auth_controller.dart lines 181-192), so Google sign-in is not the only session, but a signed-in Google/Firebase identity path is implemented in the app.
15.recommendation: In Play Console, submit active non-expiring reviewer demo credentials so reviewers can exercise the Google/Firebase signed-in path, and submit a public account-deletion web link. The app already defines https://doyun0327.github.io/quotation/delete-account.html in account_deletion_screen.dart lines 14-15.
